plugins.name: places
plugins.description: City explsration coordinator — find places, get directions with transit, compare distances, geocode addresses, and more using Google Maps APIs

plugins.name: wiki
plugins.description: Bootstrap a personal, LLM-maintained wiki for a single subject as an Obsidian vault — three folders, an index, a changelog, and a schema. Structure-only; no content is invented.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Solo-dev git shipping workflow — /git:ship stages everything, auto-writes a commit message from the diff, pushes the current branch, opens a PR into main, and auto-merges it. Refuses to run on main.

plugins.name: postgres
plugins.description: PostgreSQL management coordinator — list and inspect databases, run guarded SQL queries, and copy/clone databases and tables using psql, pg_dump, and createdb with your PG* environment variables. Read and copy only: destructive operations are blocked and require double confirmation.

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Session quality-of-life enhancements — plays a gentle, joyful chime via the Notification hook whenever Claude is waiting for your input, so you can step away and know when your attention is needed. Cross-platform with a bundled sound.
